{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for unique values in key columns
print(f"Unique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique severities: {df['severity'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique assay_batch: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if there are any control-arm patients with moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"Control arm, moderate severity count: {len(control_moderate)}")

# Check the responded column
print(f"Responded values: {df['responded'].unique()}")"}
